lead: Sunil Chhetri is best known as an Indian association football player, born on 3 August 1984 in Secunderabad.
As of 2026, he is 42 years old, and his birth date places him under the Leo sign.
He has represented Sporting Kansas City and Dempo S.C. and has been recognised with Arjuna Award and Padma Shri in sports.
This profile collects the Sunil facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Sunil Chhetri — Career and Professional Work
paras: Sunil Chhetri works primarily as an association football player.

(from 2011 to 2011), East Bengal Club (from 2008 to 2009), Sporting CP B (from 2012 to 2013), JCT FC (from 2005 to 2008) and Mohun Bagan AC (from 2002 to 2005). He plays as a forward.
